title: Player removed without death count increment
explanation: A state_snapshot at frame 665 (event: state_snapshot) shows the player alive with stats.deaths = 0. Later, at frame 351 (event: player_removed) the player is removed, implying death or exit, yet there is no corresponding increment of stats.deaths or a player_died/hurt event. This contradicts the expectation that player removal should be reflected in the death counter.
suspected_code: player_lifecycle handling – missing update of stats.deaths on player_removed
